name: Digital Scrapbook
tagline: An archive of a life, popping in on twos.
description: Personal, nostalgic manifesto film: soft grey paper with a breathing vignette, huge tight grotesk cropped over dashed guides, captions typed word by word with a block cursor, 8-bit pixel keepsakes orbiting and popping in with spark bursts and ink puffs on twos, a cyan lens flare sweeping from the edge, red ballpoint scribbles, red flash frames and thermal-camera silhouettes.

signature: pop-in on twos: an object appears with an orange spark burst or a black ink puff, overshooting in 2-frame steps
a cyan four-point lens flare sweeps in from the frame edge and whites out into the next scene
red flash frame with a white zig-zag scribble burst (2–4 frames) as a hard cut
exposure ramp: a dark silhouette heats up through a black→red→orange→yellow gradient map
avoid: clean vector icons instead of pixel or hand-drawn ones

camera: A flat scrapbook page: no camera moves beyond small drifts and focus pulls (objects blur in and out of depth); energy comes from cuts, pops and doodles.

texture.notes: Soft grey paper, a heavy vignette that breathes, film grain, ballpoint ink, pixel-art with hard black outlines, thermal imagery, smear frames.

lighting: Flat paper light under a dark vignette; black scenes lit only by thermal colour and lens flare.
sound: Lo-fi: tape hiss, typewriter/keyboard clicks for each typed word, 8-bit blips on each pop, a camera-flash zap on the red frame, a soft synth pad under the thermal shot.

motionSummary: Moves like a hand-animated diary on twos: words type behind a block cursor, keepsakes pop in with spark bursts, a cyan flare whites out the page, a red flash frame cuts, a silhouette heats up, and the pen circles what matters.

composition: a flat paper page under a breathing vignette; black pages for the inner world
huge cropped lowercase type over dashed guides that bleed off both edges
keepsakes in a loose orbiting ring with depth of field, never a tidy grid
doodles on top: red ballpoint circles, zig-zags, a pixel-font handle in a corner
visual.shapeLanguage: hard-outlined 8-bit sprites (crisp pixels), wobbly ballpoint strokes, four-point flare stars, jagged scribble bursts, a solid block cursor
visual.contrast: soft grey paper and near-black with spot colours that each mean one thing: red = pen and flash, cyan = flare, orange = sparks, the heat map only on black

grammar.pacing: fast scene changes (≈8 per 10 s, scenes 15–35 frames) but each scene is internally animated; flash frames 2–4 frames; short holds that are never dead
grammar.rhythm: stepped, on twos (motion.step 2): every drawn thing changes every 2nd frame; typing per word on 3–5-frame steps; cursor blinks on 8-frame cycles
grammar.easing: pops overshoot in discrete steps (0.55 → 1.3 → 0.9 → 1.0 over 6 frames); ease.enter overshoots by design; morphs are steps:4; nothing glides
grammar.acceleration: snappy and hand-made: objects arrive in one step, wobble twice and stop; drifts are slow and on twos; smear frames replace motion blur
movement: word-by-word typing behind a block cursor
pop-in with spark burst or ink puff, staggered 3 frames
flare sweeping from the frame edge
exposure ramp into a heat map
ballpoint strokes drawing on with a wobble
grammar.density: busy but readable: one hero action per scene (typing, popping, sweeping) with 1–2 ambient wobbles (vignette, cursor, ring)
grammar.holds: short (10–20 frames); held frames keep a cursor blinking, a ring turning or a vignette breathing

transitionPresets.name: Typed carry
transitionPresets.build: a caption keeps typing across a hard cut; the cursor jumps to the new scene and the next word lands there
transitionPresets.sound: the keyboard click continues straight through the cut

transitionPresets.name: Flare sweep
transitionPresets.build: the flare enters from the frame edge, sweeps across while growing, blooms and whites out the page; the next scene is there when the white drops (light-matte wipe)
transitionPresets.sound: a tape-warble whoosh that peaks at the white

transitionPresets.name: Pop build
transitionPresets.build: the next scene is built object by object: each pops in on twos with an orange spark burst or a black ink puff, staggered 3 frames
transitionPresets.sound: an 8-bit blip per pop, pitch rising

transitionPresets.name: Red flash frame
transitionPresets.bridge: nothing: a hard cut with an exclamation mark
transitionPresets.build: 2–4 frames of solid red with a white zig-zag scribble burst, two drawings alternating on twos, then hard cut to the next scene

transitionPresets.name: Heat ramp
transitionPresets.build: the silhouette's luminance ramps through the gradient map black → deep red → orange → yellow until it reads as a thermal image

transitionPresets.name: Sprite match
transitionPresets.bridge: a sprite or letter with the next scene's shape
transitionPresets.build: hard cut from a keepsake or letter to a scene built on the same shape and colour in the same place (heart → red flash, coin → sun)

archetypes.name: Cropped manifesto word
archetypes.composition: two huge lowercase words ('what do') cropped off the right edge over two dashed guides, the last letters greyed
archetypes.elements: display type, dashed guides, the handle
archetypes.motion: letters pop in on twos; the guides crawl; the word drifts left

archetypes.name: Typed thought
archetypes.purpose: say the thought, word by word
archetypes.composition: one small bold lowercase sentence on paper, left-aligned, a block cursor at its end; the vignette tightens while it types
archetypes.motion: words land on 3–5-frame steps, cursor blinks on 8-frame cycles

archetypes.name: Keepsake ring
archetypes.composition: 6–8 pixel sprites in a loose orbiting ring, front ones sharp, back ones blurred; a typed caption below
archetypes.elements: sprites, spark bursts and ink puffs, caption
archetypes.motion: pops staggered 3 frames, ring turns slowly on twos
archetypes.camera: flat, focus falloff toward the back

archetypes.name: Heat portrait
archetypes.composition: a profile silhouette on black heating up into a thermal map, a white typed caption beside it
archetypes.motion: exposure ramp, a slow drift on twos

archetypes.name: Doodled end card
archetypes.composition: loose letters scattered and drifting, a red ballpoint loop circling one, the handle; or the big word back
archetypes.motion: letters drift and rotate on twos, the pen draws with a wobble

sequence.cutRhythm: fast: ≈8 cuts per 10 s, scenes 15–35 frames, cuts land on clicks and snares; flash frames 2–4 frames; inside every scene the drawing runs on twos

scenes.action: 'what do' pops in letter by letter over crawling dashed guides; the last letters grey and cropped
'what do you keep when everything changes?' types word by word, the vignette tightens
coin, heart, cassette, plant, pad, floppy, star, camera pop in with sparks and ink puffs; 'the small things.'
3 red frames with a white zig-zag; a profile heats up into a thermal map; 'you keep them.'
k-e-p-t drift loose, a red ballpoint loop circles the k, @lost.and.kept; hold on the blinking cursor

elements.text: display words pop in letter by letter (stepped overshoot); captions type word by word with a block cursor and can continue across cuts; nothing fades in
elements.logo: a handle or pixel mark that pops in with a burst and then sits in a corner; on the end card it is doodled around
elements.icons: original 8-bit sprites with hard black outlines only; never vector or emoji icons
elements.images: rare: a silhouette or photo treated as thermal, posterised or grainy; enters by heat ramp or flash cut
elements.ui: none, or a tiny pixel-font label
elements.shapes: ballpoint loops and zig-zags that draw on with a wobble; flare stars; scribble bursts; dashed guide lines that crawl
elements.background: grey paper with a breathing vignette; black for inner scenes; red for one flash frame
elements.particles: spark bursts (orange lines) and ink puffs (black blobs) on pops, 4–8 frames, on twos

audio.sync: typed words on keyboard clicks, pops on 8-bit blips locked to off-beats, the flash frame on a snare or zap, the flare on a tape whoosh; scenes cut on clicks
audio.sfx: tape hiss, keyboard clicks, 8-bit blips, a camera-flash zap, a tape-warble whoosh, a warm pad under the thermal shot
